title: Filter Change Service Terms of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
Terms governing filter changes under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs, addressed to the building owner.

**Term 1. Status of the program.** Filter changes are performed only while the program stands in active or pending renewal status. The status is the one the company's program record shows for the program on the day of the visit; a program in quoted, suspended, expired, cancelled or declined status receives no filter change.

**Term 2. Grade, visits and belts.** Filters are fitted at the tier's grade and at the tier's number of visits per year, spread evenly across the year, and belts changed at the same visit are included where the tier includes them.

**Term 3. Sets beyond the year's credit, and grade above the tier's.** A set fitted beyond the year's credit is charged at the tier's extra set price, and a set fitted at a higher grade than the tier supplies is charged the difference. The year's credit is the filter sets credited to the program for the program year; the sets fitted in the year are counted over the filter change visits recorded on the program whose day of fitting falls in the current program year, from the first day of the term through the last day of the term, both days included.

**Term 4. Disposal.** Where the tier includes disposal, used filters are taken away; where it does not, they are left on site bagged.

**Term 5. Shipping.** Shipping is charged per delivery where the tier does not include it, whatever the number of sets in the delivery.

### The terms restated as conditions and results

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Program in active or pending renewal status | A filter change may be performed |
| Program in any other status | No filter change is performed |
| Set fitted within the year's credit | Included in the program |
| Set fitted beyond the year's credit | Charged at the tier's extra set price per set |
| Set fitted at a grade above the tier's grade | The difference in price is charged |
| Tier includes disposal | Used filters are taken away |
| Tier does not include disposal | Used filters are left on site, bagged |
| Tier does not include shipping | One shipping charge per delivery, regardless of the sets delivered |

### Illustration on hypothetical inputs

A program holds a credit of 20 sets for the year and 18 sets have been fitted so far in the program year. A visit that fits 4 further sets brings the year's total to 22 sets: 2 sets are within the credit and 2 sets are beyond it, and the 2 sets beyond it are charged at the tier's extra set price each. At a tier that does not include shipping, a delivery of 1 set and a delivery of 12 sets each carry one shipping charge of the same amount.
